author: The Current
description:
Festival director Nick Novotny has tips for visiting Rochester Thaw Music Festival
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Nick Novotny, founder and festival director of the Rochester Thaw Music Festival in Rochester, Minnesota, shares tips for out-of-towners planning to go to Rochester for the festival. Rochester Thaw Music Festival happens Saturday, March 21, 2026; find more information at thecurrent.org/giglist

author: The Current
description:
Eugene Hütz of Gogol Bordello sings praises of producer Nick Launay
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

During a studio session at The Current, Eugene Hütz reflects on Gogol Bordello's collaboration with Nick Launay, whom Hütz calls "one of my favorite producers of all time," along with co-producer Adam “Atom” Greenspan, who was "quintessential to the process" of making Gogol Bordello's latest album, "We Mean It, Man!"
